description: Cohort label carried by every row

note: Housing density and animal metadata are NOT in the export; they are mock metadata linked to the mock-experimental-metadata dataset note.

description: The capacitive signal cannot be attributed to an individual in a shared cage
note: The cage group is the feature of interest even though the individual subjects are known, because the sensor measures the cage.

description: First lifecycle event to the end of the export
note: Time-bounded assignments for both the cage group and each member subject.

description: Cage placed in / removed from the rack
note: Online/offline validity intervals generated by the rack-controller cage-detection assessment.

description: Cloud bookkeeping events for the cage record

description: Redundant local-time decomposition of the timestamp

description: Proprietary 1-min locomotion index derived from 12 capacitive electrodes
note: No HCMO observation subtype accepts a numeric activity result about a cage group; the generic sosa:Observation is used.

description: Cohort-level aggregates across online cages per bin
note: Statistical summaries are derivable from the per-cage observations; HCMO records primary observations only.

description: 12-electrode capacitive sensing board under each cage, 4 Hz

description: Rack-level hardware collecting board data

description: Rack-level temperature and relative-humidity sensor
